reason: My clients bring or hire their own architect, and renders already come out of the architecture fee. I'm not adding $1,500 a home on top of that on a 1-6 home year.
objection: Is $1,500 a home worth it on our margins when the architect or designer already covers 3D for the client?
would_change_my_mind: If it replaced something I already pay for, or if I could charge it through to the client as a line item so it costs me nothing, I'd take the free lunch demo.
